title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is steady. Kula Ag had mostly shade over the last hour; cloud reaches about 6,900 ft (Puunianiau camera in cloud). Upslope has run since about 08:30 at a light 3 mph, and thermals seem light. Trades are holding the shear line at Pukalani, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
